name: orbit-crew
description: The Orbit Crew: agents of Majarrah Nexus that work on the Majarrah server, called from your own Claude Code. Its first member is Saher, the code reviewer: Saher reviews a GitHub pull request on the server and shows the report in your session. The server is not open to everyone: you need an access token from Majarrah Nexus, and a GitHub token of your own.

saher_access_token.title: Majarrah access token for Saher
saher_access_token.description: The token that Majarrah Nexus made for you, for the service Majarrah Saher. It starts with mjt1. Keep it like a password.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: A GitHub token of your own. Saher reads the pull request with it. Give it read access only (Contents and Pull requests), and only to the repositories you want reviewed.
